edges.reason: Backpropagation applies the chain rule layer by layer.

evidence_a.quote: compute the derivative of a composite function by multiplying the derivatives of its parts

evidence_b.quote: applies the chain rule layer by layer from the output back to the input

edges.reason: Gradient descent consumes the gradients that backpropagation produces.

evidence_a.quote: updates parameters in the direction of the negative gradient of the loss

evidence_b.quote: used by gradient descent to update the weights
